test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Not mince words

options.text: To speak in a garbled way
Not to come directly to the point
To speak in a direct way

solution:
The correct answer is **'To speak in a direct way'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **'Not mince words' **means:
 
• If we say that **someone does not mince their words**, it means that they ***speak in a forceful and direct way, especially when saying something unpleasant to someone.***
 
• If we **observe the options**, the last option **'****To speak in a direct way'** serves the same.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's **understand **the meaning with **some more examples**.

 
• She did **not mince her words **when she talks to my friend.
 
• Bank employees do **not mince their words** while dealing with the customers.
